notes.title: Update 1.1.0 | Chapter 1.5
notes.content:
The latest update to version 1.1.0 with the release of chapter 1.5:

News:


 New SOLO mode added.
 New SOLO mode achievements added.
 New save system added.
 Save logo indicator added.
 Now, when you return from your trip, you reappear in the teleporter room..


Modifications:


 Option menu visual enhancement.
 Improved server-client coop system (in progress).
 Improved flashlight projection design.
 Modification of background sounds on the "Garfield Village" map and the "Rifly Station" map.
 Modifying images for achievements.
 No need to restart the game after deleting a savegame.
 Improved English translation.
 Improved menu.
 Improved skin-changing interface [COOP]..
 Improved fast travel system [COOP].
 Modification of the loading screen of the trip, you reappear in the teleporter room [COOP]..


AVERTISSEMENT:

Following changes to the saves system, COOP mode data has been deleted to avoid any conflict with your session.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

Tree Games Interactive

notes.title: Journey To Destiny V1.0.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Here are some bug fixes:


 Added two portals on the map: Garfiel Village for players to choose their path.
 Added music to announce the success of each puzzle.
 Fixed the doors on the Rifly Station map.
 Fixed text display bug in the inventory.


If you have any other bugs, don't hesitate to report them on the Discord server, they will be quickly fixed

Tree Games Interactive

notes.title: 100 wihslists & Annonce
notes.content:
Hello explorers

I would like to thank you for being more than 100 players to wishlist the game: Journey To Destiny.

Thanks to you, I'm very happy to have passed the first level of wishlists and that always gives me so much motivation to advance and improve the project.

Dev points:


 The game is slowly moving towards its release! I'm in the last phase of production which is the optimization to fully enjoy the game.

 Visual improvements. I'm making changes to different maps to improve the environment.


I will announce on the social networks Twitter and Discord the availability of the game.

Twitter

Discord

If you are interested in the game, but you are alone, you can try to find a teammate on the discord server.

Don't hesitate to share the game on social networks to make the game known and I thank you for all your support!
